body:
The 417Hz Frequency Bracelet is a wearable clearing tool—designed to work in harmony with the 417Hz Generator to help dissolve dense energy, shift stagnant patterns, and support you through transitions and timelines shifts. Associated with clearing negative influence and undoing energetic “noise” from past experiences, 417Hz acts as a reset frequency for both your field and your subconscious.

This bracelet is built to anchor that energy into your body. Each bead has been intentionally selected to support release, resilience, and confident movement forward—so you’re not just clearing what no longer serves, you’re actively stepping into what does.

In moments of change, old patterns, fears, and attachments can surface. This bracelet functions as a stabilizing ally, helping you:

  • Release energetic imprints and stagnant emotional residue

  • Maintain your center as you shift habits, timelines, and identities

  • Stay grounded while you take bold, aligned action

Benefits of Wearing This Frequency:

  • Supports the release of old patterns, karmic residue, and emotional heaviness

  • Encourages courage, willpower, and confident forward movement

  • Protects your field from draining, chaotic, or interfering energies

  • Enhances intuitive clarity and aligned decision-making

  • Strengthens your connection to your inner truth during transitions


The Formula

  • Bumble Bee Jasper – A stone of bold transformation and awakened purpose. Encourages courage, willpower, and stepping fully into your path, especially during times of change or reinvention.

  • Tibetan Agate – A protective, spiritually charged stone that shields the aura from negative influences and energetic interference. Supports karmic clearing, spiritual protection, and grounded confidence.

  • Zebra Jasper – Balances yin and yang energies, helping you stay rooted and optimistic while you move through change. Encourages persistence, emotional stability, and staying the course.

  • Natural Crinoid Fossil – Carries ancient Earth wisdom and deep-time perspective. Helps you release fear, integrate past lessons, and remember your resilience across lifetimes and timelines.

  • Clear Quartz – The master amplifier that holds and broadcasts the 417Hz frequency through the entire bracelet. Clarifies intention, heightens awareness, and strengthens the clearing effect.

  • Pyrite – A frequency anchor for confidence, protection, and aligned action. Shields against energetic drain, supports strong boundaries, and helps you move toward your goals with grounded power.

  • Mother of Pearl – Softens emotional edges and provides a nurturing, protective cocoon for the heart. Helps you release old emotional imprints gently, while opening to new experiences with grace.

  • Tibetan Yellow “Soccer” Agate – A solar-plexus activator for courage, joy, and inner strength. Supports self-trust, decision-making, and clearly stepping into the next aligned version of yourself.

This is your energetic clearing ally in wearable form—perfect for anyone moving through transition, releasing old timelines, or working intentionally with the 417Hz Generator to rewrite their story.
